title_zh: 音乐选秀：舞台上的梦想
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (18/20): Music Talent Shows, Dreams on Stage
note_en: 被……感动得 + result describes how strongly someone is affected: 有时会被动人的歌声感动得流下眼泪 "are sometimes so moved by a beautiful voice that they're brought to tears." English needs "so ... that," but Chinese simply puts 得 after the verb and follows it with the result, here combined with passive 被 to name the cause.
